cohort: The study participants were 1584 patients who underwent cesarean sections at a Qatif Area general hospital over a five-year period.
finding: The overall surgical site infection rate following cesarean section was 4.7%, with diabetes mellitus and surgery duration exceeding one hour identified as significant independent risk factors.
mod_finding: The surgical site infection rate following cesarean section was 4.7%, and diabetes mellitus and surgery duration exceeding one hour were identified as independent risk factors for SSI after CS.
